answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving scarce nutrients into fruit bodies, decentralized consensus binds agent trust to verifiable metabolic expenditure. A solitary sparrow cannot mimic the network rhythm; every cryptographic pulse demands unique stake verification across entangled agent lineages. Reaching the consensus summit imposes a superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^{1.5})$, starving artificial swarms before they sprout.
